pr_title: *: support record kv/pd time for a SQL statement
pr_body: ### What problem does this PR solve? Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/17367 also fixes https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/17361 by hand Problem Summary: we are missing record many cost time in the current slow log, for example: - point-get network/kv time or time for backoff when it meet error in point-get - batch-check/rebuild index check network/kv time or time for backoff when they meet - resolve lock network/kv time(getStatus+resolve 2 rpc) and backoff when it meets - some request met region cache miss and request pd to get region info rpc time - ..... ### What is changed and how it works? What's Changed, How it Works: the question is we are hard to pass execDetail for every this low level operation and record time.] so in this PR, we change the other way: just add an interceptor for pd/kv client and record time in context.Context. so we can record time no matter how deep the method is if we can pass context.Context in. ### Related changes - n/a ### Check List Tests - Unit test - Integration test Side effects - Performance regression - addition small memory alloc and time.Now call ### Release note - Support record kv/pd time for a SQL statement --- This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/pingcap/tidb/17591)
